{{Quote|I'd like to welcome you all to Uffel. My name's LV-15, and I'll be your guide for the first part of today's tour.|LV-15|<ref name="Something Uffel">{{LivingForce|Broken Orbits: Something Uffel}}</ref>}}
'''LV-15''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that was manufactured on [[Uffel]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] that was populated entirely by [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. In c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the droids of Uffel opened up their facilities to outsiders, and LV-15 was assigned to work as a tour guide. He met a tour group&mdash;which included the [[Heroes of Cularin]]&mdash;at the Uffel landing pads, and escorted them to the [[City/Legends|city]] [[X2-4]], where he handed the tourists over to the droid [[HG-211]]. He later escorted the tour group to X2-4's [[Battle droid/Legends|military-grade droid]] production facility, and he explained to them how the factory had been recently brought offline due to an act of sabotage.

==Personality and traits==
LV-15 was programmed with a masculine persona. He was friendly, and spoke with a deep, smooth voice.
